deadline.value: Applications open September 14, 2026; the Fall 2027 deadline is January 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: The deadline for Fall 2027 applications is January 1, 2027.

gre_general.value: The department says GRE scores are not required for admission; self-reported scores are allowed.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are NOT required for admission to our graduate programs.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is required, since the department does not require GRE scores.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are NOT required for admission to our graduate programs.

supervisor.value: The department page does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department says it supports all PhD students who stay in good standing through assistantships.
funding.quote: The Chemistry Department fully supports all Ph.D. students who remain in good academic standing via Graduate Teaching or Graduate Research Assistantships

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is required and the department admits only to the PhD programme.
entry_route.quote: A Bachelor’s degree is required and your major need not be chemistry

also.quote: the Chemistry Department currently only accepts students into the PhD program

notes: The department says it cannot offer application fee waivers; the Graduate School waivers still apply, so fee_waiver is not overridden. Department says it gives a strong preference to TOEFL 90 (internet) and recommends IELTS 7.0; these are preferences, not minimums, so no overrides. Chemistry says it has no master's track.
